current_article.paragraph: Her “Palmful of Stars” appeared in *Indian Literature* in its January–February 2015 issue.[^palmful] The story offers a particular title to seek out, beyond the broad description of a filmmaker who also writes. Reading her fiction is one way to approach that part of her practice on its own terms, before asking how a story might change on screen.
current_article.citation: [^palmful]: Biyot Projna Tripathy, “Palmful of Stars”, [*Indian Literature* 59(1)](https://www.jstor.org/stable/i40188158), January–February 2015, pp. 119–124.
current_article.assessment: Accurate bounded bibliographic introduction. It identifies journal/issue/pages but offers no close reading, translator claim, Odia original title or film-adaptation assertion.
